name: DPP Conformity Assessment Body
description: Issues UNTP Digital Conformity Credentials to suppliers and manufacturers.
summary: Conformity assessment body wallet for workflows/dpp-workflow.md on the NOOP trust framework. It issues the UNTP DigitalConformityCredential (dcc, jwt_vc_vcdm signed with its did:web, numeric status list index) to the supplier or manufacturer that holds it, before the workflow starts. Its DID is the one verifiers pin as the assessment body.
